doc:
### PROPOSAL-15 — Nordic Minimal - **slug**: `nordic-minimal` - **Vibe**: Scandinavian calm — near-white, soft stone grays, a muted deep blue, and airy spacing; quiet and precise. - **Best for**: Settings, user flows, and daily overview screens — calm surfaces that let numbers breathe. Adjectives: calm, precise, airy. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f6f6f4` | Near-white stone canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#ececea` | Hover/raised surfaces | | `--border-subtle` | `#e2e2de` | Fine hairline separators | | `--border-default` | `#c9c9c4` | Standard stone borders | | `--border-focus` | `#3d5a80` | Muted deep-blue focus | | `--text-primary` | `#1d2733` | Near-black blue headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#47505c` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6d7580` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#3d5a80` | Muted deep-blue primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#324a6b` | Action hover (darker blue) | | `--color-earnings` | `#3e7a5a` | Muted spruce-green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#336549` | Earnings hover (deeper spruce) | | `--color-automation` | `#5b748f` | Slate-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#b08a3e` | Muted ochre warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#b3543f` | Muted terracotta failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(61, 90, 128, 0.10)` | Blue tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(62, 122, 90, 0.10)` | Green tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(91, 116, 143, 0.10)` | Slate tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Inter Tight", "Inter", sans-serif` at 600-700 with slight negative tracking — precise and neutral. Sans: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps and IDs. Numerals `tabular-nums`; labels quiet, sentence-case, `letter-spacing: 0`. - **Radii & Borders**: Soft and quiet — cards 12px, buttons pill, inputs 10px. Borders are 1px hairlines (`--border-default`). Shadows are very soft or absent; spacing does the hierarchy work. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Soft pills; primary = muted blue fill with white text (AA, 6.5:1); secondary = white with 1px border; tertiary = text-only in blue. Focus = 2px `--border-focus` ring with a gap. Hover = 1px lift, no glow. - **Cards**: White with a 1px hairline border and a barely-there shadow (`0 1px 3px rgba(29, 39, 51, 0.06)`); generous internal padding. Hover raises the shadow one notch. - **Badges/Status**: Soft neutral pills with a small dot; publishing = slow-breathing blue dot; published = spruce dot; failed = terracotta dot. All muted, never saturated. - **Tables**: Hairline separators only, generous row padding, header in semibold small caps; row hover = `--bg-surface-elevated` wash. - **Forms/Inputs**: White fields with 1px border; focus = blue border. Labels sit above in secondary text; errors in terracotta below. - **Loading**: Three small muted dots; determinate = a thin soft progress bar. - **Signature detail**: The calm itself — muted deep blue on near-white, hairline separators, and generous air; nothing demands attention twice. - **Motion & Animation**: Slow and calm — 300ms `ease-out`; elements fade in with a 4px upward drift. Transitions are so gentle they feel automatic; no bounce, no snap. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
Earnings $12,480 +14.2%
```
